objective: Independently enumerate the complete reduced R49 coefficient/t/j conditions with direct integer congruence tests, then reconstruct all resulting candidates.
prior_exposure: The auditor previously reviewed the old residue kernel and was told its survivor result. This follow-up does not claim blind review. The new implementation is constructed from the contract and class equations; the old kernel, ledger, candidates, and verifier will not be reread, imported, copied, or executed. The root agent compares old and new artifacts only after this result freezes.

contract.inputs: Nonnegative finite BF16 magnitudes 0<=x<=a; positive subnormal derived F32 scales only for this enumeration
contract.scale: s=RN32(a/6), round nearest ties even, gradual underflow; unnormalized D=s*2^149

derivation.t_range: For each A, compute the largest positive integer strictly below the exact rational upper bound; do not hard-code class t maxima.
derivation.safe_modulus: For each class enumerate its legal v and all S31..33, compute every m=min(16+v+S-2q,q), then use the smallest m as the necessary fixed-modulus filter.
derivation.j_range: For each rounded D use every integer 1..floor(D/65536), including a possibly empty range; do not use a modular inverse or gcd generator.
derivation.epsilon_zero: The t lemma requires epsilon=+/-1. Epsilon-zero scales are analytically excluded because a carry j must be a positive multiple of 2^q. Nevertheless every relaxed A,t,j branch is recorded and its congruence evaluated; epsilon-zero divisibility is separately tested and those branches are never mislabeled as t-lemma survivors.
derivation.reconstruction: For every retained epsilon=+/-1 congruence survivor reconstruct X for every legal class v and every S31..33. Test positivity, integer divisibility, the full physical BF16 input bounds, actual interval width, exact remainder, and carry. If a legal candidate survives, compare exact canonical output against independently implemented rational nearest-even p49 output.

outputs: Complete per-A/t branch ledger, including empty ranges and epsilon-zero dispositions
All coarse survivors and all reconstruction dispositions
Derived t ranges, safe moduli, exact counters, environment, failures, and source/protocol hashes
Complete command output, review report, and frozen SHA256 manifest

counted_check_units.congruence_checks: One direct integer congruence evaluation per enumerated A,t,j, including diagnostic epsilon-zero rows.
counted_check_units.epsilon_zero_divisibility_checks: One j modulo 2^q evaluation per epsilon-zero A,t,j row.
counted_check_units.reconstruction_checks: One full-equation X reconstruction per retained candidate,v,S branch.
counted_check_units.canonical_comparisons: One exact-versus-RNE49 canonical comparison per legal physical and selected-interval candidate.
counted_check_units.note: These are exact counts of declared predicate checks, not counts of every low-level Python arithmetic operation.

result_policy: Do not assert an expected coefficient/t count, survivor count, survivor identity, or absence of a counterexample. Preserve every observed survivor and any mismatch or internal failure.
allowed: Local standard-library integer/rational reduced-condition enumeration and read-only source-head verification.
prohibited: Raw BF16 (a,x) enumeration, GPU, install/compiler, network, external messaging, Git mutation, other-paper work, old kernel/ledger/candidate/verifier reads, or writes outside this independent directory.
